The structural issue in b is therefore more serious than the minor missing intro/conclusion in a. Consequently, response a demonstrates better logical coherence and wins.

coherence_stylistic.explantion: Both responses are reported to maintain a consistent formal academic style with no tonal, complexity, perspective, or abrupt style shifts. Since neither response exhibits any stylistic flaw, there is no basis to declare a winner.

According to the hierarchy, when mechanisms are equally absent, the answer with richer examples and quantitative details is superior. Hence, response b provides deeper coverage.
